featured_reviews.name: Derrick D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
After my wife's inability to cook due to orthopaedic issues, I was scanning the mobile for some outside caterer to fill in the void. And my eyes happened to see the food app " Tiffinkart " which instaneously caught my attention. I was not on the wrong track when I made my choice and both of us, decided to try out this catering avenue.
I got in touch with Mrs Sharmila and after a brief discussion about the rates and menu to go with, hit on her Tiffinkart app to get her to deliver food for us at our residence.
On the very first day of receiving her tiffin (one veg, the other non veg) we were delighted to see such mouth watering fare, vis-a-vis the price attached to it. oHer food is very tasty, and delicious and easily digestable. This Lady is very accommodating, kind, gentle and understanding towards the need of the hour.
However, my interaction with her made me feel like she is a family member. This is an added quality to the food she serves. No wonder a clientele stretches from Churchgate to Virar as far as I know.
Its amazing how this young, charming lady can meet the needs of those in need of good food to feed themselves.
My to all is that I have tried, tested and am still enjoying the meals coming from her gracious kitchen.

For anyone seeking delicious and reliable meals, Tiffinkart is a fantastic choice. I highly recommend them for their exceptional food and service.

featured_reviews.name: The Lucky Guide
featured_reviews.review_text:
One night, I had this terrible craving to eat khichidi, and I remembered that someone suggested trying this place out as they have great vegetarian options. I browsed their menu on Google and found a mixed vegetable khichidi to be interesting. I called and placed the order, and I was told in 30 minutes that the parcel would arrive and the bill was 170/-.

Though I found it to be expensive for a simple khichidi, I was expecting really mind-blowing with all the suggestions I received. I waited, and I waited, and I waited till I finally lost patience as the time frame crossed an hour and still no khichidi. I call, and this girl/woman/lady answers the call and gives me jazz about why the order is taking so long, cleverly done coz when a female answers the call out of traditional respect we don't scream and shout at them and with this these people get away with what they do.

All said and done, the khichidi arrived cold and tasted very basic. In the name of vegetables, it had beans, carrots, and capsicum. The portion was ok, not great, nor bad. It's definitely not worth paying 170/-, maybe what I can do is cook a khichidi one day and ask them to taste it for reference when they decide to charge you 170/- for food that tastes like it was cooked for a hospital and served cold.

This place is no longer on my try again list. Maybe the other items on the menu might be good, and people like what they serve; however, I've not seen a lot of people who actually know what food is all about.
